_about: Golden set for the Jev spike. Expected values are editorial judgements, dated 2026-09-25. Field values are a verbatim span of the line, null (no such part), or a list of acceptable spans. 'source' is the domain the line came from; it only feeds the unit-system probe. 'kind' follows the README test: would you buy it or get it out? Revised 2026-10-04: resolve to the most specific entry the text supports (L08 -> butter); extraction is not scored for not_ingredient lines; a recipe's expected 'optional' lists tags that may appear but are not required; CORE_FIELDS (quantity, unit, size, ingredient) is the headline extraction score because prep and note are display only. 'one_pot' stays unaccepted for R03 until tag definitions exist.

recipes.title: Chicken tikka masala
recipes.method_summary: Marinate the chicken, grill until charred, then simmer in the spiced tomato sauce for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Shakshuka
recipes.method_summary: Soften the pepper and spices in one pan, add tomatoes and simmer, then crack in the eggs and cook covered until just set.

recipes.title: Slow-cooker beef and ale stew
recipes.method_summary: Brown the floured beef, add everything to the slow cooker and cook on low for 8 hours. Serve with mash.

recipes.title: Chilli con carne
ingredients: 1 heaped tsp hot chilli powder (or 1 level tbsp if you only have mild)
1 tsp sugar (or add a thumbnail-sized piece of dark chocolate along with the beans instead, see tip)
plain boiled long grain rice to serve
recipes.method_summary: Fry the onion, pepper, garlic and spices, brown the mince, then simmer with tomatoes, stock and beans for about an hour. Serve with rice and soured cream.

recipes.title: Classic Victoria sandwich
ingredients: half a 340g jar good-quality strawberry jam
recipes.method_summary: Beat butter, sugar, eggs, flour and baking powder, bake in two tins for 20 minutes, then fill with buttercream and jam.

recipes.title: Best chocolate chip cookies
ingredients: 2 cups minus 2 tablespoons cake flour (8 ½ ounces)
1 ⅔ cups bread flour (8 ½ ounces)
1 ½ teaspoons coarse sea salt, plus more for sprinkling
1 ¼ cups unsalted butter (2 ½ sticks)
1 ¼ cups light brown sugar (10 ounces)
1 cup plus 2 tablespoons granulated sugar (8 ounces)
1 ¼ pounds bittersweet chocolate disks or fèves, at least 60 percent cacao content (see note)
recipes.method_summary: Cream butter and sugars, beat in eggs and vanilla, fold in flours, leavening and chocolate, chill the dough for 24-36 hours, then bake at 350F.

recipes.title: Chop suey (chicken stir fry)
ingredients: 1 1/2 tbsp light soy sauce (, or all purpose soy(Note 3))
1 1/2 tbsp vegetable oil ((or other cooking oil))
5 - 6  stems choy sum ((or other Asian greens))
1/2 cup sliced mushrooms ((shiitake is authentic, but any will do))
recipes.method_summary: Velvet the sliced chicken, stir fry with garlic, onion and vegetables over high heat, then toss in the sauce until glossy. About 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Beef stroganoff
ingredients: 600 g / 1.2 lb   scotch fillet steak / boneless rib eye ((Note 1))
1/2 tsp cooking salt / kosher salt ((halve for table salt, +50% for flakes))
300 g / 10 oz   mushrooms (, sliced (not too thin))
2 cups beef broth (, preferably salt reduced)
250 - 300 g / 8 - 10 oz   pasta or egg noodles of choice ((Note 3))
recipes.method_summary: Sear thin strips of steak, cook onion and mushrooms in butter, make a sauce with flour, broth, mustard and sour cream, return the beef and serve over pasta or egg noodles.

recipes.title: Leek and potato soup (vichyssoise)
ingredients: 450g potatoes peeled and cut into 1cm pieces  (try Golden Wonders or Kerr Pinks)
1 small onion cut the same size as the potatoes
450g white parts of leeks sliced  (save the green tops for another soup or stock)
recipes.method_summary: Sweat potatoes, onion and leeks in butter, simmer in stock until soft, blend with cream and milk, and serve hot or chilled with leek and chives.

recipes.title: Chicken jalfrezi
ingredients: handful of fresh, chopped coriander leaves
cooked basmati rice or naan bread to serve
recipes.method_summary: Blend onion, garlic, chilli and tomatoes into a sauce with spices and cook down, fry the spiced chicken with onion and peppers, then combine and simmer. Finish with garam masala and coriander.

recipes.title: Chicken biryani
ingredients: 4 skinless chicken breasts cut into large chunks
30g coriander ½ chopped, ½ leaves picked and 2 tbsp toasted flaked almonds, to serve
recipes.method_summary: Soak the rice, fry onion with whole spices, add chicken and curry paste, layer with rice and raisins, pour over stock and cook covered until the rice is tender.

recipes.title: Fish parcels and tomato orzo
ingredients: 2 x 130g chunky white fish fillets, skin on, scaled, pin-boned, from sustainable sources
recipes.method_summary: Cook orzo in a quick tomato, garlic and chilli sauce with peppers and courgette, then bake the fish in foil parcels on top for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Chickpea arrabbiata
recipes.method_summary: Fry garlic and chilli, add passata and chickpeas, simmer briefly, toss with torn fresh lasagne sheets and rocket, finish with Parmesan.

dietary.why: Labelled vegetarian by the site, but Parmesan is made with animal rennet. Derivation from the hierarchy must catch this.

recipes.title: Easy roast chicken
ingredients: 1 bunch of mixed fresh herbs such as thyme, rosemary, bay
recipes.method_summary: Roast a whole chicken on a bed of onion, carrot, celery and garlic with lemon and herbs for about 1 hour 20 minutes, rest it, and make gravy from the tray.

recipes.title: Vegan chilli
ingredients: 2 sweet potatoes peeled and cut into medium chunks
1-2 tsp chilli powder (depending on how hot you like it)
lime wedges guacamole, rice and coriander to serve
recipes.method_summary: Roast sweet potato with spices, fry the onion, carrot, celery and pepper, simmer with tomatoes and beans, and serve with lime, guacamole, rice and coriander.

dietary.why: No animal products on any line.

recipes.title: Greek salad
ingredients: 4 large  vine tomatoes cut into irregular wedges
1 cucumber peeled, deseeded, then roughly chopped
½ a red onion thinly sliced
85g feta cheese cut into chunks (barrel matured feta is the best)
4 tbsp Greek extra virgin olive oil
recipes.method_summary: Chop tomatoes, cucumber and onion, add olives, feta and oregano, and dress with olive oil. No cooking.

dietary.why: Some feta uses animal rennet; the hierarchy needs a per-product flag or an 'unknown' state.

recipes.title: Easy pancakes
ingredients: 1 tbsp sunflower or vegetable oil plus a little extra for frying
recipes.method_summary: Whisk flour, eggs, milk and oil into a batter, then fry thin pancakes one at a time. Serve with lemon and sugar.

recipes.title: Easy egg-fried rice
recipes.method_summary: Cook the rice, fry the onion, push aside and scramble the eggs, then toss everything together over high heat with spring onions.

recipes.title: Easy naan bread
ingredients: ½-1 tsp strongly-flavoured seeds such as nigella or cumin seeds (optional)
small handful of coriander finely chopped, plus extra to serve
recipes.method_summary: Make a yogurt dough with flour, sugar, baking powder and seeds, rest it, roll into ovals and cook in a hot dry pan, then brush with garlic butter.

recipes.title: Shepherd's pie (household notes)
ingredients: cheese on top if feeling it
recipes.method_summary: Brown the mince with onion and carrot, add puree, worcester sauce and an Oxo with water, simmer, top with mash and cheese, bake at gas 6 for 30-40 minutes.
